# Open App

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Opens an app on the device.

## Syntax

~~~~text
openApp(id: <#string#>, id: <#string#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
openApp(id: com.zlineman.jellyfish, id: )
~~~~
